title: Invitation tickets are counted as collected revenue
description: Approval stores price = ticket type price, discount_amount = 0, is_paid = true. All revenue queries sum price - discount_amount over is_paid tickets.
expected_behavior: A free invited guest adds 0 to collected revenue.
actual_behavior: Each approved invitation adds the full ticket-type price to event and platform revenue.
recommendation: Set discount_amount = price (net 0) or exclude payment_method='invitation' from revenue sums; add a report test.

title: Review emails are sent inside the DB transaction while holding a row lock
description: TicketIssued (line 93) and InvitationRequestRejected (line 60) are sent inside DB::transaction after lockForUpdate (line 53).
expected_behavior: An email is only sent for a state that has committed; locks are not held across network I/O.
actual_behavior: If the commit fails after sending, the guest holds a QR for a non-existent ticket (or a rejection for a Pending request); slow SMTP holds the row lock.
performance_impact: Row lock held for SMTP round-trip
recommendation: Commit first, then send via a queued mailable with ->afterCommit().

title: Ticket issuance logic duplicated a third time
description: Ticket number format, QR secret, workshop key and TicketIssued email re-implemented.
actual_behavior: Three copies that must be changed together.
recommendation: Extract a TicketIssuer service used by payment completion and invitation approval.

title: Eight strings on the new screens have no Arabic translation
description: Missing: Category, Social, We received your request, We received your request., Influencer Category, Other, Tell us your category, TikTok.
expected_behavior: All UI copy renders in Arabic in the Arabic locale.
actual_behavior: These strings fall back to English.

title: Landing-page confirmation banner cannot be dismissed
description: Fixed-position banner with no close control or timeout.
expected_behavior: Banner can be dismissed or fades out.
recommendation: Add an Alpine x-data close button / timeout.

title: Deleting a ticket type cascades to invitations and their requests
description: ticket_type_id cascadeOnDelete on invitations, invitation_id cascadeOnDelete on invitation_requests, and no guard in TicketTypeController::destroy.
expected_behavior: Review history is retained or deletion is blocked.
recommendation: restrictOnDelete or block deleting ticket types in use; offer deactivate.

title: Approval issues tickets for ticket types deactivated after the invitation was created
description: Generation requires an active type; approval does not re-check.
actual_behavior: Inactive tier can still be issued.
recommendation: Decide and document; optionally warn in the admin UI.

title: No test for revenue or check-in of invitation tickets
description: Suite covers the flow thoroughly but not its two downstream consumers.
evidence: grep of tests for EventReport + invitation returns nothing
expected_behavior: Tests guard revenue and check-in for invitation tickets.
recommendation: Add a report test and a check-in test.
